name: Begonte (Spain)
description: White field with a vertical stripe chequy of red and yellow at one third from the hoist, the fly charged with a yellow scallop shell between five red towers.
history: The arms and flag of Begonte were approved in 2014, published in the Diario Oficial de Galicia on 20 October 2014; the flag is a white cloth with, at one third from the hoist, a vertical stripe chequy in four rows of red and yellow, and at the fly a shell between five towers.

features.role: chequy stripe of four rows at one third from the hoist
